method: Durations use integer sixteenth-note units: half=8, quarter=4, eighth=2 and sixteenth=1. A 4/4, 3/4 or 2/4 measure therefore holds 16, 12 or 8 units respectively. A seeded Mulberry32 generator chooses only durations that fit the remaining measure; half notes start on a quarter-note beat. Events never cross barlines. When rests are enabled, quarter and shorter events can become rests with 24% probability; if the exercise otherwise has no rest, one eligible event is converted or a half note is split into two quarter events. The same settings and trimmed seed reproduce the same exercise. Counting labels divide each quarter-note beat into 1, e, & and a.
